_note: pip install minihack (needs setuptools<81). MiniHack-MazeWalk-9x9-Allocentric-v0 is minihack_levels' twin of MiniHack-MazeWalk-9x9-v0 with pixel_crop fixed on the level's map, so the level holds still and the agent moves; mazewalk9x9_egocentric.json plays MiniHack-MazeWalk-9x9-v0 itself, the egocentric view, a 9x9 window centred on the agent.
